priors: Both programs receive the same cell, element types, Laue rotations and centring. Native symmetry prior is decoded from the exact SHELXT SYMM/LATT instructions. No exact space group, atom counts or coordinates supplied.
eligibility: Exact equality of nonresonant Laue rotational sets and pure-translation subgroups, in the supplied index basis. Retain excluded/contradicted settings as diagnostics.
processing: Use supplied symmorphic Laue/centring for the initial P1 map; never fabricate observed equivalents or zeros. Preserve actual measured evidence statuses.
acceptance: Supplied prior recovered; measured Laue not contradicted
Without a supplied prior, no unresolved strict higher Laue superset
More common Friedel families than model parameters
No different group type among configured BIC-close successful alternatives
For acentric candidates, completed diagnostic inversion test with alpha >0.3
Common R1 <=0.08 and selected phase alpha <=0.3
fallback: Same original shared absolute deadline. Accepted deeper candidate may upgrade the first. When neither pass is accepted, preserve an existing first approximation; otherwise retain an available deeper approximation. Save both pass reports and available maps.
primary_grading: Saved top model, exact non-H element counts, common origin/inversion, RMS <=0.025 A and max <=0.05 A; report space-group number separately. No reference-based alternative selection.
secondary_grading: Same geometric gates without element identities when total atom counts match; diagnostic only.
measurement_policy: Sequential warm-cache process wall timings including failures; no task-owned compilation, tests or profiling during collection. Save/hash every prediction before reference grading. New output directories only.
